lead: Work through the queue of reported content. Every decision is recorded and the author can appeal it. Heavily reported content is hidden automatically.
emptyHint: The queue is empty. Good work.
author: Author

note.label: Reason shown to the author
note.hint: The author receives this message and can appeal the decision.
note.template: Hello {{name}}, your {{type}} was reported for “{{reason}}”. Please read the community rules again.

HIDE.title: Hide the content
HIDE.lead: The content of {{name}} stays visible to its author, who can appeal to the team.

WARN.title: Warn the author
WARN.lead: {{name}} will receive this warning in their notifications. The content is also hidden.

SUSPEND.title: Suspend the author
SUSPEND.lead: The account of {{name}} will be suspended and the content hidden. You can reactivate it from Users.
